binding: Python builds all data (rule 4, D1); browser JS only for browser-only duties; no CDN code on the site (AGENTS.md:71-72); 3D view behind a default-off setting; no paid or ion token in browser code; statewide products only, no saved-place list to a third party; evidence kinds, freshness limits and labels change only by DECISIONS entry (D30-D40, proposed). recommendation.architecture: Hybrid H1: design C's C2 now; C1 later and gated. C2: Python writes fixed statewide PNG frames, three SVG transects and text values into the site build; the browser draws them as Leaflet overlays on the vendored Leaflet 1.9.4 map. C1 (optional P7): vendored MapLibre GL JS (globe projection) and deck.gl 9.4.0 fed by Python-written JSON; no Cesium, no ion token, no pydeck HTML. Designs A and B stay off the app path while D27 parks the app; their rules are grafted in.
recommendation.gap: C2 does not deliver a globe, rotation, true-height clouds or 3D volumes; P1-P6 give text values, height classes, a 2-hour loop and transects on a flat map. Only C1 (P7) meets the owner's ask.
recommendation.condition: For owner decision. Conditional on fixing design_c_defects_to_fix before any build.

decisions_to_write.title: Storm layers on the site
decisions_to_write.proposed: Storm layers are fixed statewide products over the box 43.0-50.5 N, 118.5-101.0 W (gridded.py:38), behind build flag --experimental-3d, default off; the default build writes no storm files and no 3D strings. Layer menu only, not the Now first screen; four pages and four nav items stay (DESIGN.md:53-62). The flag stays off during the pilot. No place-derived file is built or sent to any host (D24, D27). Any globe code (C1) needs D-G1 first.

decisions_to_write.title: Evidence kinds for satellite and echo layers
decisions_to_write.proposed: Add satellite_image (observation; 'Satellite picture (GOES Band 13, observation)') and satellite_estimate (retrieval; 'Estimated cloud-top height; top only; cloud base not observed'; never 'measured'). Echo-top raster and MESH stay radar_estimate: 'Derived from NOAA MRMS radar data (modified; not NOAA's unaltered product)' (rights-matrix: NOAA modification limits); MESH also reads 'Estimated hail (not observed hail size; not damage)'. Base map and terrain are not evidence. No layer merges kinds; none states damage or a probability.

decisions_to_write.title: Freshness limits per product
decisions_to_write.proposed: Live if age is at or under the first limit; Stale beyond it, age shown; Unavailable beyond the second. MRMS frames (echo, MESH, PrecipRate): 30 / 180 min (30 from gridded.py:53 and sources.py:115; 180 proposed for the 2-hour loop; latency 29-120 s, mrms.json review). GOES ACHA height: 20 / 60 min (5-minute scans; S3 latency 88.9-125.3 s, goes-aws review). GOES Band 13: 20 / 60 min (median 30.2 s GOES-19, 32.8 s GOES-18). Stations: current at or under 75 min, older shown stale (sources.py:34; D25; D29). Alerts: each build; a failed refresh keeps the last verified list (D27). Page: warning past 25 min (base.html:48-57). Terrain: version-stamped; if missing, echo is Unavailable. The site's 30-min MRMS limit supersedes D27's 15 min; D12 stays for the parked app. A test fails when a layer key has no limit.

decisions_to_write.title: Library pin and integrity
decisions_to_write.proposed: Third-party browser code and fonts are vendored under website/static/ at an exact version, with LICENSE and a sha256 manifest; the build fails on any hash change; a test fails on any off-site URL in built HTML, JS, CSS or JSON (test_site.py:459-471). Pin only versions at least 14 days old (design B's rule; excludes maplibre-gl 6.14.0 until 2026-10-25). No CDN, ion or paid key in browser code. First entry: Leaflet 1.9.4, sha256 db49d009..., equal to jsDelivr. Build-time Python packages pinned likewise (website.yml:80).

decisions_to_write.title: Publish host and terms for NOAA-derived products
decisions_to_write.proposed: NOAA-derived products stay on the 10-minute Actions build and Pages (as D28's frames do) only after counsel reads three clauses: 'develop and test your application(s)'; 'don't use Actions as a content delivery network'; and 'publication of the software project' (legal reading open). If not cleared, fixed statewide files move to object storage (hosting-options.json, unreviewed: Cloudflare R2 free to 10 GB-month; S3 about $0.13-0.25 per month). Pages: 1 GB site, 100 GB soft per month; at 0.66 MB per visit that is about 150,000 visits (design-c, computed).

decisions_to_write.title: Correction: Folium does not bundle Leaflet
decisions_to_write.proposed: 'Folium bundles Leaflet' is wrong. Folium 0.20.0 loads leaflet@1.9.3 from cdn.jsdelivr.net with no integrity attribute (folium.py:27 and :40; read today). The parked app keeps those scripts (payload/maps.py:54-55). The website serves Leaflet 1.9.4 from its own files (D27; AGENTS rule 4). requirements.txt pins only folium>=0.17, so the Leaflet version follows the installed Folium.

decisions_to_write.title: Browser duty list and rule-4 check
decisions_to_write.proposed: Browser duties are exactly js_duties (E1-E7; N1-N7 for storm layers; G1-G8 only with D-G1). Anything in not_in_javascript stays in Python. A test fails on dBZ or threshold literals in browser scripts. New duties need an owner ruling and a line here.

decisions_to_write.title: Demo and sample labels
decisions_to_write.proposed: Invented layers are labelled DEMO on every page, legend and export. They cannot reach the live publish: the --require-live build fails if sample-only fields reach _site. Archived real replays are labelled 'Archived, not live' (D-G10). The 'Sample data' banner (base.html:17) becomes 'DEMO' if the owner rules that rule 5 applies.

decisions_to_write.title: Evaluation gate for new feeds
decisions_to_write.proposed: No new feed (MRMS levels, MESH, GOES) joins main until the owner approves evaluation-predeclared.json as the predeclared metrics. Passes need n of at least 20; below that results are report-only and never shown as passes (evaluation-predeclared.json:64). Fidelity metrics pass only at zero mismatches. DESIGN.md's 5-user first-click target stays separate.

decisions_to_write.title: Product data contract and refusals
decisions_to_write.proposed: map.json keeps version 1 (build.py:239) until a change bumps it; map.js refuses an unknown version with 'needs a newer build' (N7). Each product sidecar carries schema, last_run_utc, source_valid_utc, next_expected_utc, max_age_min, bytes and sha256. A missing product is Unavailable with its reason, never an all-clear; a malformed product (value outside the grid, sentinel as dBZ, no validity mask) is refused and the last verified frame stays with its age.

decisions_to_write.title: Decode rules for MRMS and GOES
decisions_to_write.proposed: MRMS -99 and -999 are 'No radar data' (hatched), never 0 dBZ or clear, until the NSSL table confirms their meaning. Negative valid dBZ are real values below threshold, not no-data or zero (test; P0 check). A cell is below ground, or within 50 m of ground, when its level is under ground plus 50 m (owner ruling D-G18); counted in the legend. ACHAC heights only where DQF = 0 (general rule refuted, goes-aws review); ACHA2KMC's DQF rule only after evidence. Parallax wording verbatim from parallax.json for the phase in force.

phases.scope: Gates; no product code on main. D30-D40 written; ROADMAP Next 1 done; counsel reads the D34 clauses; owner approves evaluation-predeclared.json. Measure: frame bytes per product on at least 48 frames; statewide below-ground share at 0.5 and 1.0 km from 1,000 random Montana points (design-c P0); -99/-999 meaning; negative-dBZ check on a 2025-06-15 file.
phases.done_when: Next 1 done (two scheduled runs in a row publish; ROADMAP.md:39). Three consecutive real builds at 12 min or less (job limit 15 min; website.yml:38).
phases.stop: Counsel does not clear D34: no product file on any host.

phases.scope: Text first (ROADMAP Next 8): echo-top height as text for the 14 towns (towns.json) in map.json, as a radar estimate with its valid-column count. No picture.
phases.done_when: 14 of 14 towns carry a value or a named reason. Zero 'dry' or 'no hail' strings (test).
phases.stop: Any height shown without its valid-column count.

phases.scope: Cloud-top height classes (ACHAC 10 km, or ACHA2KMC per D-G14) and the Band 13 picture; flag off; legend verbatim from parallax.json for the phase in force (D-G13).
phases.done_when: Zero mismatches against source on 3 recorded scenes (design-b phase 2). Geolocation p95 at most 0.5 source pixel; time error at most 1 s (design-c P1). PNG at most 150 KB per frame. Chromium at 288, 390 and 1440 px: no horizontal scroll; zero off-site requests.
phases.stop: A zero-tolerance check fails in two consecutive builds: remove the layer; the flag stays off.

phases.scope: MESH hail swath (ROADMAP Next 11; same MRMS decoder). Units confirmed first (mrms.json: 'mm likely, not confirmed').
phases.done_when: MESH metrics as predeclared in evaluation-predeclared.json. That file rejects SPC reports as ground truth for radar products, so the ROADMAP Next 11 SPC check (Benchland 1.75 in, 2025-06-15) is an example only. Report-only below n of 20.
phases.stop: Units unverified, or a zero-tolerance metric fails twice: hide MESH.

phases.scope: Echo-top raster and 1-hour window: highest valid level at or above 35 dBZ among 11 of the 33 levels, above the mask. The window needs new code (build.py:472-475).
phases.done_when: voxel_dbz_mismatch 0 on 1,000 random cells per build; threshold_count_parity difference 0; no_data_rendered_as_echo_or_clear 0; missing_slot_shown_as_gap 1.000; alert parity 0 differences on 20 fixtures; frame at most 60 KB (proposed; P0 measures); build time added at most 60 s (design-c P2).
phases.stop: Any fidelity metric above zero in two consecutive builds: hide the echo layer; P2 and P3 stay.

phases.scope: Three fixed transect SVGs, named before any data is viewed; each at most 30 KB; each states its vertical scale.
phases.done_when: estimate_label_recognition at least 0.90 with n of at least 20; false_all_clear 0 (evaluation-predeclared.json:64). The pilot has n = 2, so the result stays report-only until n = 20 (D-G15).
phases.stop: Recognition below 0.90 at n of 20 or more, or any false all-clear: no transects.

phases.scope: Two-hour loop of the echo raster: 12 frames, no interpolation.
phases.done_when: At most 0.9 MB per 12-frame loop (design-c P4); frame_time_error 0 s; decision_time_leaks 0; missing slots shown as gaps.
phases.stop: Above 1.5 MB or any leak: cap the loop at 1 hour.

phases.scope: C1 globe, gated: vendored MapLibre GL JS (globe projection) and deck.gl 9.4.0 with Python-written layer JSON; volumes only after G6 and G7 are approved.
phases.done_when: gzip-9 of both at most 0.9 MB (860,439 B today); first load at most 2.0 MB gzip (design-c P5); with WebGL2 disabled the banner shows and the 2D map works; frame p95 at most 33 ms on the D-G7 reference device; loop at most 15 MB per 2 hours (rendering-options phase 4: 14 MB at 50 dBZ, 100 MB at 35 dBZ).
phases.stop: Reference device below 30 fps or loop above 15 MB: stop at 2D.

phases.scope: Parked app. Only if D27 is reversed by an entry naming it (D-G19). Not part of this plan.

dissent.design_a: Lowest on rules (3) and engineering (3); product 3.3, owner-ask sub-score 8. Closest literal match to a CesiumJS globe with lifted clouds and volumes; its null-geometry, sub-terrain, no-data and DQF text is the most complete (grafted). Prefer A only if the owner reverses D27, accepts a local server and a Cesium library (about 11.5 MB of files; globe-libs review) with its default-token references, and wants a globe before pilot order is complete. Phone reach is nil (127.0.0.1; launcher.py:433).
dissent.design_b: Strongest route security (separate cookie, read-only database, 16 route tests); bundling meets rule 4 without a rule change; snapshot parity with Live Storms. Prefer B only if the owner revives the desktop app and accepts per-OS installers, about 35 MB of Windows wheels and a second local server. Engineering score 2: a decode child process, installer churn, WebGL2 on Windows unproven (webgl-runtime review).
dissent.design_c: C2 cannot show a globe, rotation, true-height clouds or 3D volumes; owner-ask sub-score 3 of 10. If the 3D look outranks pilot order, C1 (P7) is the route: engineering estimate about 4 (judge-engineering, unbuilt); WebGL2 on phones is a floor (caniuse via judge-engineering: iOS Safari from 15; disabled by default 12 to 14.8; not re-fetched). Design D (site globe page, vendored three.js) has no judge verdict here and is the natural next comparison for P7.
